draft.title: Taccuino del giorno · 8 ottobre 2026
draft.excerpt: Tra prestiti strategici e rientri dai nazionali, il vivaio azzurro continua a muoversi sui campi europei.
draft.excerptEn: Between strategic loans and returns from international duty, Italy's young talent pool keeps moving across European pitches.
draft.bodyIt:
**Honest Ahanor**
Il talento del vivaio azzurro ha scelto di rappresentare l'Italia, rifiutando la Nigeria e confermando la sua priorità per gli Azzurri. Ahanor si posiziona tra i migliori giovani italiani della stagione. [fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxQdGxfRWRfNTFqaFlJakM2S2FjTHhYTUR3dGdEV1pDbURQdjhwNHhLeHc4OTVTWGJKUTNIT0wyNWlyRWhvaEpRdWgwenUxbnNYMTJ1NU8xUG45ejZuTDVKd29zSVdBc0x6eldmTmNzdGVHS1d3YVBCUHlHRkJEUXR3RkZnNDU0SnhLUGhYZW53MmpiQ1lyMmpOMDRoVk9XU3M2NWJRV0lWU3hJd3d5?oc=5)

**Antonio Raimondo**
Il difensore del Frosinone si è infortunato durante gli impegni con la nazionale e salterà l'importante match contro il Napoli. Un'assenza che complica i piani della squadra laziale. [fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxOcHNZaXRwdl9OOVBaTXN0ZEtFXzRzX3pHNEFEcUM2REJmUXJQd2hBc3JEQVY5dDBFYURaOHVQU2Zua0ROSUNydUtUa3k1TXdNTWVRc0lPR1dwc0hULXdQRC1iZThPYWpOQmtDNnRhcHdIdk9qcHc3bUZXUmdZVEFIVVdaSk5EZkVMeW5EQTJKOUUzLTU5dHdsdldoQ0VvMGpQdGJKNjVEOFV2emxTaHhwNW1oNHU2Y2FpMXdnRmVB?oc=5)

**Luigi Cherubini**
In prestito ai giallorossi, Cherubini ha trovato il gol in azzurro mentre la difesa continua a mostrare solidità. Una prestazione che sottolinea il valore della soluzione prestito per la crescita del giovane talento. [fonte](https://news.google.?oc=5)

**Eddy Kouadio**
L'esterno del Monza si ritrova a valutare il suo percorso in nazionale dopo non aver esordito in Azzurro. Una situazione che richiede chiarezza sui progetti futuri con la maglia italiana. [fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxPRjhyNlRsNmthaHR0MEk4RjNwZTkzOExOOUpxdS11TzhvYnBQMUVac2xSckRlOHJFOGMyM3BWS1E2SmFvemxKY1ZiUEFiamhiMHVFR0d6a2JIN2Jjb1JDcEFsQ2xncDRVQ3VGY3JTd3RCZUgtdTdydVFJTWZGYkhpZU1GLTZDY3J6TzlXM21HWkZ5QkZXaUVN?oc=5)

draft.bodyEn:
**Honest Ahanor**
The academy talent has chosen to represent Italy, turning down Nigeria and confirming his priority for the Azzurri. Ahanor ranks among the best young Italian players this season. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxQdGxfRWRfNTFqaFlJakM2S2FjTHhYTUR3dGdEV1pDbURQdjhwNHhLeHc4OTVTWGJKUTNIT0wyNWlyRWhvaEpRdWgwenUxbnNYMTJ1NU8xUG45ejZuTDVKd29zSVdBc0x6eldmTmNzdGVHS1d3YVBCUHlHRkJEUXR3RkZnNDU0SnhLUGhYZW53MmpiQ1lyMmpOMDRoVk9XU3M2NWJRV0lWU3hJd3d5?oc=5)

**Antonio Raimondo**
The Frosinone defender suffered an injury during international duty and will miss the crucial match against Napoli. His absence complicates the Laziali's plans. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxOcHNZaXRwdl9OOVBaTXN0ZEtFXzRzX3pHNEFEcUM2REJmUXJQd2hBc3JEQVY5dDBFYURaOHVQU2Zua0ROSUNydUtUa3k1TXdNTWVRc0lPR1dwc0hULXdQRC1iZThPYWpOQmtDNnRhcHdIdk9qcHc3bUZXUmdZVEFIVVdaSk5EZkVMeW5EQTJKOUUzLTU5dHdsdldoQ0VvMGpQdGJKNjVEOFV2emxTaHhwNW1oNHU2Y2FpMXdnRmVB?oc=5)

**Luigi Cherubini**
On loan at the Giallorossi, Cherubini scored for Italy while the defense continues to display solidity. A performance that highlights the value of the loan solution for developing young talent. [source](https://news.google.?oc=5)

**Eddy Kouadio**
The Monza winger is assessing his path with the national team after failing to make his Azzurri debut. A situation requiring clarity on future projects with the Italian shirt. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxPRjhyNlRsNmthaHR0MEk4RjNwZTkzOExOOUpxdS11TzhvYnBQMUVac2xSckRlOHJFOGMyM3BWS1E2SmFvemxKY1ZiUEFiamhiMHVFR0d6a2JIN2Jjb1JDcEFsQ2xncDRVQ3VGY3JTd3RCZUgtdTdydVFJTWZGYkhpZU1GLTZDY3J6TzlXM21HWkZ5QkZXaUVN?oc=5)
